name: Rubino (tube type)

origin.basis: Italian bicycle-tire brand; Vittoria's international store is set to Italy (EUR).

manufacturing.basis: The store page does not state where the tire is made.

positioning: Vittoria's everyday training clincher with a Graphene + Silica compound.
weight_basis: Vittoria store weights for black sidewalls; tan is 10 g lighter.

availability.note: Sold by Vittoria's international web store; Rubino tires are sold by Shimano-linked Tmall stores in mainland China; North American availability not verified.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price incl. Italian VAT on 2026-11-01; shipping calculated at checkout. One tire.

caveats: Bicycle Rolling Resistance's 2016 Rubino Pro Speed test is not applied.
